user_text: Perfect, that's done. I'm pretty tired, honestly.
text:
Get some rest. Before you go, though, my last message got cut off mid-table, so it's not actually complete. Here's what's missing:

- The end of the budget table (contingency fund and totals)
- The services cancel/start timeline
- The room-by-room packing checklist and declutter tips
- The 6-8 week phone reminder calendar
- The one-page printable moving-day essentials

I can send these whenever you're ready, either all at once or one at a time. The one-pager and calendar are probably the most useful to have next.

**One correction:** I listed Klamath Falls as an Oregon emissions-test area, and that's wrong. DEQ testing applies only in the Portland metro area (Multnomah, Washington, Clackamas) and the Medford area. Please confirm on Oregon DEQ's site once you know where you'll register.

**One timing note:** 10 weeks from now puts you in mid-July, which is peak moving season. Truck and mover availability is tightest and prices highest then, so getting quotes and booking in the next week or two matters more than anything else on the list. It's also hot, so plan early-morning driving legs for the dog.

You don't need to do anything tonight. Just tell me when to pick back up.
